name: The college site

layers.essential_history: [[c:South of the church stood a college of priests, built as a cloister. Today only the earthworks and the church itself remain.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:The college was finished around 1430. Much of it was destroyed in the 1500s.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:In the cloister garth, Kit the page admits he was meant to guard the rose but fell asleep. He saw someone with a candle walk towards the river.]]

evidence: [[c:Kit saw someone with a candle walking towards the river.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head south, about 130 metres as the crow flies, to the bridge over the Nene.  Keep to pavements and public paths.]]
